_meta.datasheet_section: Table 2 Pin Description + Figure 1 (top view); Ordering Information p13; Dimensions/land pattern p10 (2.5 x 2.0, POD-PQFN-004-X02025-010)
_meta.package: 4L PQFN 2.5 x 2.0 x 0.75 mm (package code '1'); recommended land: 1.1 x 1.0 pads at 1.9 (long axis) x 1.5 (short axis) centre spacing
_meta.notes: Decode: B = revision, I = -40..85 C, '-' = default drive, '1' = 2.5x2.0, '2' = +/-25 ppm, '18' = 1.8 V +/-10%, 'E' = output enable, no packing suffix = bulk. 40 MHz is a listed standard frequency.

pins.name: OE
pins.note: H = output on, L = output high-Z. Use a pull-up of 10 kOhm or less if not driven; internal 50-150 kOhm. VIH 70% Vdd, VIL 30% Vdd

pins.name: VDD
pins.note: 0.1 uF or more between VDD and GND required
